description:
Query HD wallet data for XRP (Ripple) by extended public key (xPub). The wallet must first be synced via manage_hd_wallet. Offset pagination: use 'limit' and 'offset' for paged results.

Actions:
• derive-receiving-address: Derive the next unused receiving address
• list-addresses: List all derived addresses for the wallet
• list-transactions: List transactions across all wallet addresses
• list-assets: List token/asset balances held by the wallet
• get-details: Get wallet summary (total balance, address count, sync status)

Credits by action (source: OpenAPI):
• derive-receiving-address: 24
• get-details: 12
• list-addresses: 12
• list-assets: 12
• list-transactions: 90

Credits are indicative only and may change at any time. The actual credits spent for each API request are returned in the response headers.

context.description: Optional context for the request - echoed back in response

limit.description: Max results per page (for list-* actions)

network.description: XRP network (mainnet or testnet); required for all actions

name: hd_wallet__hd_wallet_data_xrp
